NIH-supported research can boost
reproductive health, but it needs your help

plain_text:
ndometriosis is when cells from the lining
of your uterus grow in other areas of your
body. Some places they can grow are on or
under your ovaries and fallopian tubes. This can
be painful or cause heavy bleeding and bleeding
between periods. It can also make it hard to get
pregnant (infertility). This condition occurs in
about 10% of women of reproductive age.

plain_text:
There is no cure for endometriosis, but NIH
supports research to find new treatments.

plain_text:
The Endometriosis: Natural History, Diagnosis,
and Outcomes (ENDO) Study observed two
groups of women at risk for endometriosis.

Pelvic pain from endometriosis can look
